books.title: The Map to Nowhere
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: In the attic, Noah found an old map in a dusty trunk. At the bottom it said, 'The Map to Nowhere.'
Noah laughed. 'A map to nowhere? That sounds like an adventure!' He packed a sandwich and set off.
The map led him over the hill, across the stream, and into a wood he had never explored before.
At the end of the path, Noah found a tiny cottage with a blue door. An old lady waved from the window.
'Welcome, traveller,' she said. 'I have been waiting for someone to follow my map.' She gave him tea and cake.
Noah stayed for the afternoon and heard wonderful stories about the wood. When he left, the old lady said, 'Nowhere is the best place to find something new.'

books.title: The Moonlight Picnic
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: On the night of the full moon, the whole family packed a picnic and walked up the hill behind their house.
They spread a blanket on the grass and opened the basket. There were sandwiches, apples, and a big thermos of hot chocolate.
As they ate, the moon rose higher and higher. It was so bright that they could see the whole valley below.
'Look!' whispered Dad. 'Owls!' Two owls flew silently across the moonlit sky.
The children told stories and sang songs until the moon was high above them. Then they packed up and walked home.
That night, tucked in bed, Lily thought about the moonlight picnic. It was the best dinner she had ever had.

books.title: The Kind Giant
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: At the top of the hill lived a giant called Bruno. He was so tall that his head touched the clouds.
The villagers were afraid of Bruno, so he lived alone. He was lonely, but he was kind, and he helped lost birds find their way home.
One day a little girl called Ana climbed the hill. 'Hello,' she said. 'Why do you live all alone?'
Bruno told her he was lonely. Ana smiled. 'Come to the village with me. Everyone will love you once they know you.'
Bruno was nervous, but he followed Ana down the hill. The children cheered when they saw him, and he helped them pick apples from the tallest trees.
From that day on, Bruno lived in the village. He was still the tallest, but he was never lonely again.

books.title: The Birthday Surprise
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: It was Sara's birthday, but Sara did not know that her friends were planning a big surprise party for her.
Her best friend Mia decorated the house with balloons and ribbons while Sara was at school. Her mother baked a chocolate cake with pink candles.
When Sara came home, the house was dark and quiet. "Hello?" she called. Suddenly, all the lights came on, and everyone shouted, "Surprise! Happy birthday!"
Sara laughed and clapped her hands. They played games, sang songs, and ate the delicious cake together.
At the end of the day, Sara hugged her friends and said, "This is the best birthday ever. Thank you for the wonderful surprise!"
